title: Term sbār / law of inquiry
problem: Translation “probe” over-literal for سبَار in this theoretical context
action: Render as “instrument of investigation and a rule”; preserve physical-instrument analogy.
evidence: §2; N003; lexicon of سبر; user’s teacher guidance
resolution_2026-11-05: Published translation uses “instrument of investigation”; retained in final reader.

title: al-mutakallimīn in the craft
problem: “Those who discuss this craft” is defensible; do not mechanically render as “theologians”.
action: Retain sense of technical practitioners; compare other occurrences before standardization.
resolution_2026-11-05: Reads mutakallimūn as kalām practitioners, qualified by discipline.

title: Relational good and bad outside things
problem: “No existence outside the concrete entity” creates an unintended intrinsic-property implication.
action: Render “no existence as intrinsic properties of things in external reality”.
resolution_2026-11-05: Intrinsic/external moral-qualification distinction preserved.

title: The phrase al-lafẓ al-māniʿ
problem: اللفظ المانع من الفحشاء is unexpected; perhaps compressed or corrupt account of prayer.
action: Retain printed wording; compare Bou Akl and Mustaṣfā before modifying translation.
resolution_2026-11-05: Unclear اللفظ retained, English marks uncertainty; no defensible manuscript emendation.

title: Harm or benefit and the threat of punishment
problem: لا يتصور دون الضرر أو النفع is counterintuitive as justification for threatened punishment.
action: Keep printed Arabic pending manuscript evidence; explicate al-Ghazālī’s intentions/benefit argument.
evidence: §17; N124; Bou Akl Arabic §23 p130 / French p131; Mustaṣfā
resolution_2026-11-05: No deletion of لا or أو النفع; doctrinal relation to harm/benefit noted.

title: Following vs widening prayer times
problem: اتباع أوقات أكثر الصلوات in al-ʿAlawī may need اتساع and changes the time argument.
action: Recheck manuscript-supported reading, do not silently adopt.
resolution_2026-11-05: اتباع retained; no warrant to silently replace with اتساع.

title: Minimum valid performance applies to both examples
problem: Former “In the latter case” ambiguously excluded wiping the head.
action: Clarify latter class of unquantified obligations includes wiping and bowing.
resolution_2026-11-05: Minimum-performance rule applies to both examples in the unquantified class.

title: Abrogation: permissibility argument inverted
problem: Former editorial supplement “[is the error of supposing]” reversed author’s argument.
action: Restore affirmative “Clearer still is its reversion to prior permissibility”.
evidence: §26; N011; Bou Akl Arabic §34 p136 / French p137, commentary p354
resolution_2026-11-05: Abrogation construed positively as return to original permissibility.

title: Defective appeal to extended-time obligations
problem: Conditional construction around لفظة إيجابه مطلقا is defective in printed source.
action: Preserve bracketed uncertainty; seek BA reading and al-Mustaṣfā.
resolution_2026-11-05: Lacuna signaled; French critical translation used for argued sense, Arabic not faked.

title: Readiness to receive reason
problem: الولي بشرط الاستعداد لقبول العقل admits multiple antecedents and temporal readings.
action: Annotate the relation between capacity, responsibility and guardian.
resolution_2026-11-05: The readiness and intellect clauses retain their distinct scopes.

title: المستثنى vs المنتشي
problem: “Excepted person” conflicts with intoxication argument; editorial interpretation is “one becoming intoxicated”.
action: Collate with al-Ghazālī before elevating المنتشي into the base Arabic.
resolution_2026-11-05: المستثنى kept as 1994; contextual المنتشي in bracketed English.

title: Compressed motivation clause
problem: The close of the section on belief/motivation is grammatically hard to construe.
action: Label bracketed English as conjecture, seek source witness.
resolution_2026-11-05: Unrecoverable motivational clause disclosed; no invented source.

title: مكانه or إمكانه
problem: “His place” vs “his possibility/capacity” affects legal agency explanation.
action: Confirm with critical edition.
resolution_2026-11-05: مكانه printed, إمكانه argued in apparatus.

title: Prepaying zakāt from corrupt verb
problem: Printed كمن قوم الزكاة على الحول is translated as “advancing zakāt before completion of the year”.
action: Validate proposed قدّم before accepting interpretation as text.
resolution_2026-11-05: Corrupt form noted; English prepaying zakāt labelled contextual.

title: Basmala analogy negation
problem: 1994 لم يصرح reverses the comparison with taʿawwudh and qunūt.
action: Adopt Bou Akl’s proposed sense “was expressly stated”; retain 1994 Arabic reading with critical note.
evidence: §64; N126; Bou Akl Arabic §81, French and commentary p373; Mustaṣfā
resolution_2026-11-05: Bou Akl §81 lam yuṣarraḥ → qad ṣurriḥa, shown in angle brackets.

title: Attribution of statement “The Messenger said”
problem: Textual formula citing divine speech alongside wording of a Companion’s narration is unstable.
action: Flag attribution; compare full passage and critical Arabic.
resolution_2026-11-05: Source attribution inconsistency documented; not silently repaired.

title: Lacuna and imported Zarkashī parallel
problem: A witness gap is supplemented from later citation (al-Zarkashī), not authorial certainty.
action: Preserve witness/supplement differentiation in every edition and site.
resolution_2026-11-05: Reconstruction distinguishes Zarkashī from the independent witness.

title: Broken report/knowledge transition
problem: Printed transition into قلنا raises a missing clause and speaker/argument sequence.
action: Expose uncertain reconstruction, verify with alternate edition.
resolution_2026-11-05: Printed text unresolved; interpretive supplement disclosed.

title: Compressed report conclusion
problem: Reasoning about obligation to heed report includes compressed or ambiguous inferential step.
action: Reconstruct premise–conclusion explicitly in note before rewriting.
resolution_2026-11-05: Compressed report conclusion remains source-faithful with qualification.

title: Unknown “to God” in Bedouin testimony
problem: مجهولا عند الله literally means “unknown to God”; context asks whether narrator was unknown to Prophet.
action: Check manuscript; conjectural عنده, avoid perpetuating “unknown to God” as doctrine.
resolution_2026-11-05: Prophet rather than God intended; printed Arabic variant retained.

title: Fāsiq mutaʾawwil: suspicion vs intrinsic disqualification
problem: لموضع التهمة in second position reverses intended contrast; testimony allowance also puzzling.
action: Record Bou Akl’s supplied “and not” before suspicion; distinguish al-Qāḍī/Abū Ḥanīfa gloss, no silent rewrite.
evidence: §91; N036; Bou Akl French §115 p189, commentary p392
resolution_2026-11-05: Supplied ⟨لا⟩ matches Bou Akl §115 French editorial interpretation.

title: al-tajarruḥ ʿan al-thiqāt
problem: Printed التجرح عن الثقات is morphologically/technically obscure for trustworthy transmitters.
action: Cross-check BA and transmitter-critical usage.
resolution_2026-11-05: بالقول [أ] witnessed; ⟨التصريح⟩ editorial per Bou Akl §119.

title: Zarkashī supplement status
problem: Bracketed clause imported from later witness potentially looks authorial.
action: Maintain distinct typography and source attribution.
resolution_2026-11-05: Zarkashī parallel identified; no spurious manuscript authority.

title: Jarḥ vs riwāya
problem: لا يجرح إلا عن عدل is likely corrupted form of لا يروي إلا عن عدل.
action: Seek independently attested wording; keep English contextual with note.
resolution_2026-11-05: No evidence for forcing جرح to رواية in every place.

title: Abrogated recitation: missing negative
problem: ينبغي أن يقبل ... حتى يتواتر is rendered with bracketed “[not]” needed by argument.
action: Explicitly identify English negation as conjecture; compare BA witness; no silent Arabic change.
resolution_2026-11-05: Missing negative in recitation/abrogation not claimed manuscript verified.

title: Incomplete conditions for earlier laws
problem: Missing clause between نقلها and على الأمة is supplied conjecturally.
action: Retain gap/edition variant note; compare Bou Akl manuscript.
resolution_2026-11-05: Bou Akl manuscript marginal addition and old conjecture distinguished.

title: Duplicated affirmative in contrary opinions
problem: Both positions read من يجوزه, although contrasted camps require one negated.
action: Keep [do not] identified as conjecture, check BA edition.
resolution_2026-11-05: Interpretive [do not] distinguished from original reading.

title: Feminine ending and generic nouns
problem: Examples الثمرة/النخلة/المرأة bear feminine suffix while sentence discusses its absence.
action: Clarify these are examples of singulative effect / excluded generic use; do not claim morphological typo without proof.
evidence: §170; N070; Bou Akl §205 and commentary p435–436
resolution_2026-11-05: Singulative feminine ending conflicts with examples: reader no longer falsely presents them as clean examples.

title: Composite Qurʾānic citation
problem: Quoted “... except a present trade” fuses Q4:29 with formula of Q2:282.
action: Identify precisely as composite textual quotation, keep Ibn Rushd wording distinct from scripture.
resolution_2026-11-05: Composite Qur’anic citation explicitly tagged, not source-normalized silently.

title: Qurʾān 17:23 citation initial conjunction
problem: Edition prints ولا تقل لهما أف where canonical verse has فلا تقل لهما أف.
action: Retain source reading but annotate canonical form.
resolution_2026-11-05: Exact Qur’an 17:23 variant recorded without altering Ibn Rushd citation.

title: “Thread and needle” hadith
problem: Printed الخائط is normally “tailor”; hadith requires الخياط “thread”.
action: Source-critical apparatus; cross-link parallel in §215.
resolution_2026-11-05: Hadith wording contextualized in critical note.

title: Elliptical genre/form exposition
problem: List of verbal forms and their meanings is compressed and difficult to delimit.
action: Give grammar note for meaning of grammatical categories.
resolution_2026-11-05: Elliptical exposition presented as such.

title: Command as mental content
problem: الأوامر العامة بالنفس vs familiar القائمة بالنفس affects discussion of command in the soul.
action: Keep brackets visible and seek BA printed variant.
resolution_2026-11-05: Mental-discourse wording left unaltered without warrant.

title: After-prohibition imperative: double nadb
problem: الاقتصار is taken as الاقتضاء and الندب appears twice where إيجاب/ندب contrast is expected.
action: Correct in English with explicit conjectural marks; verify Arabic.
resolution_2026-11-05: الاقتضاء [أ], ⟨الوجوب⟩ conjecture; إيجابا [أ] correction.

title: New command vs specified command
problem: محدد is translated [renewed], apparently for مجدد.
action: Check Arabic witness; crucial to debate if make-up requires a new command.
resolution_2026-11-05: مجدد [أ] replaces 1994 محدد.

title: Ijzāʾ / jazāʾ and misplaced exception
problem: الجزاء and إلا جزاء conflict with context of الإجزاء; changes answer to whether command discharges duty.
action: Retain source variants and supply argued الإجزاء / لا يقتضي الإجزاء in critical text if supported.
resolution_2026-11-05: الإجزاء / لا يقتضي الإجزاء [أ] replaces damaged 1994 readings.

title: Fourth rank and wrong third-rank referral
problem: “Third rank within meaning of the original” conflicts with sequence; second rank fits.
action: Compare BA reported manuscript reading الثانية and critical variants before changing.
resolution_2026-11-05: المرتبة الثانية [أ] replaces 1994 الثالثة.

title: Qiyās al-sunna/shabah manuscript choice
problem: Printed/editorial قياس الشبه over reported manuscript قياس السنة.
action: Retain both in source apparatus and mark preferred edited reading.
resolution_2026-11-05: قياس السنة / قياس الشبه explicitly distinguished.

title: “Contextual indications” defective syntax
problem: قرائن نظير الألفاظ ظاهرة is treated as if نظير were تصير.
action: Label “make” as contextual conjecture; collate rather than restore silently.
resolution_2026-11-05: ⟨تصير⟩ inserted per Bou Akl §273, unverified in manuscript.

title: Missing second and third kinds of prophetic action
problem: Text jumps from second kind to “intermediate between these two”; English supplies third class.
action: Preserve editorial brackets and seek BA witness; high impact for Sunnah-as-source classification.
resolution_2026-11-05: Threefold action classification reconstructed per Bou Akl §278 in angle brackets.

title: Missing near/particular member of knowledge division
problem: 1994 omits ومنها جزئية وقريبة في كونها مفيدة للعمل, distorting a twofold distinction of practical knowledge.
action: Restore source-witnessed clause visibly with angle brackets in both languages.
evidence: Bou Akl 2015, Arabic §2, p. 118 (PDF p. 128), Escorial [أ] vs al-ʿAlawī [ع].
resolution_2026-11-05: Reported Escorial addition restored in edited reading and documented as witness-based, not independently re-collated.
